papers.approved_scope: For explicitly listed rational matrices of variable positive dimensions with exact rank(A+B)=1, uniqueness of the entire mixed-strategy pair is coNP-complete and nonuniqueness is NP-complete. Arbitrary degeneracy and a supplied strict pure equilibrium are included. This is not a polynomial uniqueness algorithm, strong hardness, fixed-dimension hardness, nondegenerate-promise hardness, payoff uniqueness, or a worldwide priority determination.

For each integer d >= 7, the construction gives a smooth integral minimal complex projective surface with ample canonical bundle, K_S^2=6(d-1)(d-3), an ample integral polarization L with L^2=6, and a special point with epsilon <= 1/(d-1) < 1/(2+(K_S^2)^(1/4)). Surfaces vary with d; no exact epsilon, very-general-point violation, Picard-rank-one result, canonical-polarization result, optimality or priority claim.
